description: This file defines the EmployeeLicenseDecorator class within the OrangeHRM system. The class acts as a decorator for EmployeeLicense entities, providing methods to associate employees and licenses via IDs and to retrieve license dates formatted as strings.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmployeeLicense entity providing helper methods to set related entities by IDs and retrieve formatted license dates.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity to the EmployeeLicense by employee number.

methods.name: setLicenseByLicenseId
methods.description: Associates a License entity to the EmployeeLicense by license ID.

methods.name: getLicenseIssuedDate
methods.description: Returns the license issued date formatted as a string, or null if not set.

methods.name: getLicenseExpiryDate
methods.description: Returns the license expiry date formatted as a string, or null if not set.
